description: The exact order that would be placed: lines, discounts, shipping, taxes, the total (total_cents and total formatted), the delivery address and the payment method, and the confirm_token that checkout_place needs. Read the total from here: never calculate it. If something is missing it says what. When no API key with the scope orders:create is sent, the shop emails a 6-digit verification code to the buyer for security and says so in "confirmation": tell the person, ask for the code and wait for it.

session_id.description: Only if your client does not keep the MCP session (the Mcp-Session-Id header): the session_id that an earlier answer of this server gave you. It keeps the same cart between calls.
